a: bundleProblems marks a leaf "named twice" in a bundle that is never loaded with the other namer
copyNodes picks a copied leaf's key with uniqueKey where shiftNodes uses uniqueLeafKey, so a copy can take a key nested in another leaf's value path
Copying or moving a section re-keys only the section, so the leaves inside it can share a value path with leaves already in the target scope
aliasesTo keys a layout alias with a section root's dotted leaf key, which copyNodes rewrites with `_` instead
withRoots treats a step's asset as unchanged by the host while ignoring presets and nodeKind
printValue prints a `__proto__` key bare, so the exported literal sets a prototype instead of holding the key
b: A draft stores a list's or a map's object entry's fields as a pointer to the source's fields whenever one of them holds code, so every edit to those fields is lost on reopen
aliasesTo keys a layout's alias by the dialog's raw key, which under a section-root dialog is a dotted value path no group key may be
copyNodes and aliasNodes pick a leaf's key with uniqueKey, so a copy can land at a key holding a value inside or around a sibling's; shiftNodes uses uniqueLeafKey for exactly this
withRoots hands back the stepped asset whole when label, kind, lock and `over` match, so an undo takes back a host's later change to `nodeKind` or a Bundles asset's `presets`
Selecting action prefs that fire different unregistered keys drops the Action row silently: it is neither shown as mixed nor listed in `apart`
printValue prints a data key `__proto__` bare, so the exported literal sets a prototype instead of holding the entry
